sources.title: OPD-Evolver: Cultivating Holistic Agent Evolver via On-Policy Distillation
sources.snippet: To this end, we introduce OPD-Evolver, a slow- fast co-evolution framework where the fast loop lets the agent evolve through online interaction with environments and memory, while the slow loop distills these interaction-derived behaviors into intrinsic evolver capabilities via on-policy self- distillation.
